identity.appearance: 1444年共和自由城，评分表月河四国之一
identity.region: Luna River / East Dameshead / Empire of Anbennar

survey_region.note: 共享来源行：Luna River Minors（Rank 3；Region EoA），原表以聚合项表示四个本地月河国家；本映射不声称它们是同一EU4国家。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 蓝鹿周围一直都是野心勃勃的领主，渴望利用月河的财富。许多想要征服我们的人被我们的城市拒之门外，不是因为刀剑，而是因为语言的力量。我们的官员是谈判和平与和解的专家，即使是与最好战的军阀谈判，使我们的人民免受战争的恐怖。
description.text_en: Bluehart has always been surrounded by ambitious lords, eager to feast upon the riches of the Luna. Many a would-be conqueror have been turned away from our city, though not through the sword, but through the power of words. Our officials are experts in negotiating peace and reconciliation even with the most belligerent warlords, keeping our people safe from the horrors of combat.

description.text: 我们的城市最初是作为达梅里亚第21军团，也被称为第21「鹿」军团，的一个军营建立的，当共和国沦陷于龙醒时，前指挥官控制了局势，让惊慌失措的平民涌向他的保护下，并在突然变得无法无天的边境维持稳定。后来，他被称为鹿领主，是和平与法律的典范，当达梅里亚王国从共和国的废墟中崛起时，他欣然将新城市蓝鹿交给他们统治，就像他统治时一样平静地在睡梦中死去。我们希望继续他的遗产，作为一股善意的力量，不管我们周围的土地上有什么恐怖。
description.text_en: Our city was originally founded as a legionary camp of the 21st Legion of Dameria, also known as the Legion XXI Hart. When the Republic fell to the Dragonwake, the former commander took control of the situation, allowing panicked civilians to flock to his protection and enforcing stability across the suddenly lawless frontier. In time he became known as The Hartlord, a paragon of peace and law, and when the Kingdom of Dameria rose from the ashes of the Republic, he readily submitted the new city of Bluehart to their rule, dying in his sleep as peacefully as he reigned. We hope to continue his legacy, acting as a force for goodwill despite whatever horrors wrack the lands around us.

description.text: 除了穆纳斯港，我们的城市是月河上最大的城市。作为从威克斯山顺流而下的主要贸易目的地，蓝鹿的商人们在舒适的家中找到交易市场并不困难。
description.text_en: With the exception of Port Munas, our city is the largest on the Luna River. A prime destination for trade flowing downstream from the Wexhills, Blueharter merchants have little trouble finding markets to trade with from the comfort of home.

description.text: 旧军团营地被称为西姆塞斯提尔，尽管它已经有很长一段时间没有被用于最初的战时目的。自从鹿领主统治以来，该建筑一直被用作外交综合体，为外国政要提供舒适的住宿，并为紧张的谈判提供安全的房间。
description.text_en: The old legion camp is known as the Cymcestir, though it hasn't been used for its original wartime purposes for quite some time. Ever since the reign of The Hartlord, the compound has been used as a diplomatic complex, providing comforting accommodations for foreign dignitaries and secure rooms for tense negotiations.

description.text: 每个成员都有第21「鹿」军团的直系血统，第21军团之子是蓝鹿勇敢的哨兵，只有他们被允许在城市范围内携带武器。据说他们每个人都以十人般的凶残作战，决心保卫他们祖先为之战斗的城市，保卫他们的子孙将在这里长大，他们的子孙也将继续保卫这座城市。
description.text_en: Each member tracing direct lineage to the soldiers of the Legion XXI Hart, the Sons of the XXI are the brave sentinels of Bluehart, they alone are permitted to bear arms within city limits. They're said to fight with the ferocity of ten men each, determined to safeguard the city their ancestors fought for, that their children will grow up in, and that their descendants will continue to defend.

description.text: 当混乱在城市周围酝酿时，没有人能越过我们的城门。在这个城市里是一种宁静的氛围，基本上没有受到任何灾难的侵扰。
description.text_en: While turmoil brews around the city, none reaches past our city gates. Within the city is an atmosphere of tranquility, largely untouched by whatever calamity plagues the rest of the Empire.

description.text: 1604年，西姆塞斯提尔扩大并改建为奥罗伊盖努尔学院，这是安本纳尔组织内部酝酿的紧张局势的结果。建制派的教授们在培养下一代政治家和使者来充当和平使者的过程中找到了巨大的满足感，他们准备好修复跨越帝国的桥梁，并帮助治愈过去的创伤。
description.text_en: The Cymcestir was expanded and converted into the Olóiegéanur Academy in 1604 as a result of simmering tensions within the fabric of Anbennar. The professors of the establishment find great gratification in training the next generation of statesmen and emissaries to act as agents of peace, ready to mend broke bridges across the Empire and assist in healing the wounds of the past.

description.text:
「最伟大的统治者并非仅仅统治一个时期，而是开创一个时代——其遗产之深远、成就之卓著，令古今往来者皆黯然失色。他们深知：庇护者的终极遗产，就镌刻在被庇护者的命运之中。」
——瓦卢斯纳的托马斯，「绿衣鳏夫」，《为政之道》
description.text_en:
“The greatest rulers preside not over a mere reign but an Era, a period which eclipses those ahead and behind in its profundity and prolificity. They understand that the legacy of the patron is his clients.”
Tomás of Vallusna, ‘The Statesman’

description.text:
「风格之仿效必先师其形，进而得其神。当我们以古达梅里亚正规市集为蓝本构筑柱廊时，我们同样受到那些曾在柱影间流转的智语机锋启发，以及那种我们试图重现的结构所赋予的生活方式。论辩传统的延续，蓬勃的公共生活，乃至喧腾的抗争呐喊——皆因我们再次选择为它们预留栖身之所。」
——萨曼·弗尔巴恩,《石之生命》
description.text_en:
“The imitation of style necessitates the imitation of form, and therefore of function. When we build a colonnade inspired by the formal markets of Old Dameria, we are inspired also by the conversation held along that colonnade, the type of life enabled by the structure we seek to recreate. The rhetorical tradition, the vibrant public life, even the raucous protest – all are made possible by the decision, made once again, to build space for them.”
Saman of Fowlbarn, ‘The Life Of Stone’

description.text:
「即便在那些未将政权让渡于行会支持的市议员协会控制之下的地区，行会也早已是东月神之首地区城市生活的基本单元，这比帕沙埃内作为一个有组织的国家出现要早得多。

此种传统衍生出三重深远影响：其一，催生了某种社团民主制的法典化理念——坚信社会最佳形态诞生于代表不同民众集体的团体间相互制衡，即便这些团体最终仍须臣服于君主或所谓『执行行会』；其二，培育了以经济繁荣为导向的务实精神，造就帕沙埃内锱铢必较、闻名于世的『商人外交』；其三，孕育了对城市化进程与产业垂直整合的执着追求。」
——西尔瓦德·多夫，《坎诺经济史》
description.text_en:
“Even in those realms which had not subordinated their government to an association of guild-backed aldermen, the Guild had been the fundamental unit of urban life in the Eastern Dameshead long before Pashainé’s emergence as a coherent state.

This had three major consequences. First, the codification of a sort of corporate democracy, a belief that society was best forged under a competing set of mutually-exerted pressures, by groups representing collectives of the population - even if these were subject to a monarch or a so-called ’Executive Guild’. Second, an emphasis on economic prosperity, the brass tacks ‘shopkeeper diplomacy’ for which Pashainé became notorious. Third, a relentless focus on urbanisation and the vertical integration of industry.”
Silvard Dove, ‘An Economic History of Cannor’

description.text:
「诗人米利安曾言，帕沙埃内的高贵无与伦比——她继承了弗恩父亲的勇气，又秉持着母亲达梅里亚的端方。而身为次女的我，似乎只承袭了情欲与固执。」
「珍妮」杰娜娅·卡德斯娜·西纳·贝拉凯尔，《堕落伯爵夫人回忆录》
description.text_en:
“The poet Milian said that the Pashainéy is uniquely noble, having inherited the bravery of his Vernman father and the dignity of his Damerian mother. As a second daughter, I seem to have been left with the libido and stubbornness.”
Genaia ‘Geni’ Cadesna sina Bellacaire, ‘Memoirs Of A Fallen Countess’

description.text:
「试看科琳教与摄政王庭之间的冲突，曾使整个河谷地带割裂至此般境地。复观此地子民，既文修智启又热忱参政，将弥合神学裂痕奉为政道急务。终视揭秘会，组织架构效法行会自愿联合之根基。在这哈兰世界，再没有哪个族群，不仅愿接纳其信条纲目，更能从根本上承袭揭秘会组织精义之信众。」
——利安德·贝拉克，《卫道书》
description.text_en:
“Consider the conflict between Corinism and the Court which had so split the Valley. Consider, then, an unusually literate and engaged populace with a political impetus to see theological ruptures healed. Consider finally the Ravelian Lodge, which in its structure mimics the voluntary association basis of the guild. No population on Halann was more ready to embrace not merely the articles of belief but the basic organisational structure of Ravelianism.”
Leande Bellac, ‘Apologetics’

description.text:
「十八世纪的钟摆荡过月河，『翠绿之灾』的慢性蚕食终现狰狞全貌。曾经坎诺最膏腴的沃土尸斑遍布，耕地两年方得薄收，伴生的壤毒更将谷地仅存的天然森林噬作枯骨。乡野大流散由是启始，农村人口大规模迁移，使帕沙埃内的城市化进一步加深，帕沙埃内在剧痛中早产出现代都会的雏形——砖缝里开出的恶之花，是日后百年劳工政治的血色温床：咖啡馆的激进私语与街垒的呛人硝烟，自此成为周期性文明痉挛的预兆性颤栗。今日河谷难觅为卡米尔·席尔穆纳歌功颂德者，然这片土地的每道褶皱里，都已深深烙上那个狂人的印记。」
——卢卡斯·西尔·贝拉凯尔，《丁香河史》，第二卷
description.text_en:
“Over the course of the eighteenth century, the slowly aggregating impact of the Verdancy became more and more clear across the entire Luna watershed. Land which had once been among the most fertile in Cannor gave harvest perhaps once in two years, while the concomitant soil pollution devastated the Valley’s few remaining natural forests. The result was an exodus of the population from the countryside and an even greater urbanisation of Pashainé, inadvertently birthing a contentious café and street culture; this would dominate the labour politics of the following hundred years, erupting again and again into civil unrest. You will find few along the Valley who have much to say in praise of Camir Silmuna, but our land is indelibly marked by his legacy.”
Lucas síl Bellacaire, The History of the Lilac River, Vol. II

description.text:
「吾民，勿惧死亡！勿惧与勇者为伍，勿怯与同胞同行！我们正处于巫师王时代——法杖即真理的时代——其威仪看似不可撼动。然我等皆知，法师亦有死穴可破。

三百载前烽烟为证，当齐射战术的枪焰首度能与火球术的弧光相抗衡时，我们就已知晓；二百年前铁律昭然，当我们首次得知那种辉煌物质——当时仅在极东之地可得——能抵消他们不劳而获的恩赐时，我们就已知晓；而如今我们也已知晓——他们催长万物的仪式，他们许诺的永恒丰收，那场『翠绿之灾』！，已把昔日葱郁的生命之地化作荒芜草原。此乃他们惯行之道！荼毒大地，污染清泉，为独踞那虚妄王座，竟不惜将哈兰娜馈赠的丰饶付之一炬。

且听！诚然——今日或当赴死。然吾等共赴黄泉，彼辈孤魂永堕！」
——帕勒多克斯的卡里克，最后的演说
description.text_en:
“Do not fear death, my people. Fear nothing which you do in the company of brave souls; fear nothing which you do among your fellow citizens! We live in the time of the Mage-Emperors – in the era of the staff – and its power seems absolute. But we know these mages can die.

We knew it three hundred years ago, when the discipline of the fusillade first began to rival the arc of the fireball. We knew it two hundred years ago, when first we learned of that glorious substance, then accessible only so very far away, which could countermand their unearned gifts. And we know it now – now that their ritual of growth, their promise of endless harvest, has wrought a desolate steppe where once there was only verdant life. It is what they do! Addle the land, poison the water, wreck the bountiful Halann we share for the slightest chance at a lonely throne.

Hear me! It’s true – we may die today. But we die together, while they die alone.”
Carric of Paredocks, Final Address

player_overview.avoid_if: 想直接无视邻邦关系、靠早期大规模征服解决问题的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先稳外交并发展人力，再以皇帝关系、影响力和有限战争整合月河。
player_overview.overview: 你从东达梅里亚文化的蓝鹿开局。鹿领主与第21军团留下的不是单纯好战传统：城市更愿意说服强者，借军营和使节维持自治。先稳住邻邦、培养军官和市民兵，再参与月河影响力外交，把诸城引向帕沙埃内。
player_overview.recommended_for: 偏爱外交谈判、共和小国、稳健军事准备的玩家。
signature_features: 两项专属任务将达梅里亚关系、军官和市民兵串联。
理念中的军团旧营与外交声望形成鲜明反差。
20项共通任务把一省自由城推向联盟和形成国。
player_overview.tagline: 继承达梅里亚军团记忆，用军备作后盾，以谈判守住月河自由城。

reasons: 达梅里亚第21军团和鹿领主历史鲜明
玩家体验常认为是四城中顺手的开局
warnings: 不能把1604年学院写成1444年开局建筑

values.rationale: 国家理念与任务强调调停、城市自治、关系修复和避免被大国摆布，防卫军事服务于保护共同体而非征服。
red_flags: 联盟竞争中的有限战争
